notes: Static-address heuristic at config time with no same-module or ancestry check: a dynamic (for_each) import block in the same module as another block for the same resource is silently dropped, which reproduces the issue's bug class; it does add a solid unit test, a fixture and a plan test.

Fixes the reported root-module case, but its static-address dedup does not check ContainingModule, so a dynamic (for_each) import block silently drops another block for the same resource in the same module; keyed child modules also let the child's import overwrite the parent's at expansion; adds an unneeded CHANGELOG edit.

Matches the reference: it stops deduplicating by ConfigResource and moves the parent-overrides-child check to per-instance expansion via knownImports.Has, with plan and apply tests including a per-instance child override; the only nits are a hand-edited CHANGELOG and a possibly guessed issue number.

Matches the reference by returning every statement and deduplicating per resource instance after expansion (first wins, so the parent wins), with strong plan/apply tests including a per-instance parent/child override; the only extra is a CHANGELOG edit.

It fixes the reported same-module case, but it keeps config-time deduplication using a static instance-key heuristic that ignores module instance keys and treats dynamic `to` expressions as overlapping, so child blocks can still be wrongly dropped; there is no expansion-time dedup and only a basic test.

Static instance-key comparison fixes the reported case and simple parent/child overrides, but it ignores module instance keys, drops child imports whenever the parent's `to` is dynamic, and leaves a stale doc comment.

The best of the heuristic approaches, since it always keeps same-module blocks and compares full static addresses, but it lacks per-instance dedup at expansion, so module-instance keys and dynamic parent targets give wrong override results; it also adds unrelated child-order sorting, though it tests both for_each and count.

Correctly keeps all same-module blocks and handles static parent/child per-instance overrides, but a dynamic parent `to` drops the child's imports entirely, keyed child modules make the child win, and it adds unrelated child-sorting.

It fixes the no-module repro by keeping same-module blocks, but any ancestor import on the same ConfigResource still drops every child-module block regardless of instance, so the per-instance parent/child override stays broken.
Only fixes the same-module case; any ancestor import for the same ConfigResource still silently drops all child-module imports for other instances, the same bug class as the issue.

Fixes all block-delimiter checks plus the quoted address suffix, with good tests including a quoted `{` site address; it does not move the quoted `{}` check into the condition, and the doImport change wraps the switch in an extra `wasQuoted` guard rather than using a helper.

Correct, using Dispenser-level helpers plus a quoted-address fix and a nice quoted-address test, but it leaves the quoted "{}" line-break handling unfixed and mixes the helpers with inline wasQuoted checks in doImport.

Correctly makes every structural brace check ignore quoted braces in both the dispenser and the parser, with thorough dispenser and parser tests; it misses the quoted-address `HasSuffix("{")` case, and the stringly `isBlockBrace("{")` helper is slightly less clean than Token predicates.

Correct and well tested (dispenser and parser cases, including a snippet and a quoted '}' at line start), but the string-parameter isBlockBrace API is a bit awkward, doImport uses inline checks, and the quoted-address HasSuffix check is not fixed.

Matches the reference in substance, including the address-suffix and quoted `{}` refinements, using clean Token predicates; tests cover the dispenser, parser, imported snippets and an end-to-end adapter check, though the adapter test reaches into another package.

Matches the reference fix completely with clean Token helpers, and adds strong dispenser, parser, snippet and end-to-end httpcaddyfile adaptation tests; the cross-package test is slightly beyond what was needed but still relevant.

Clean Token predicates fix the core issue and tests are rich (backtick, heredoc, `{block}` import); it leaves the redundant `wasQuoted` check in `directive()` and skips both the quoted-`{}` and quoted-address-suffix refinements.

The core fix is correct and the tests are thorough (segments, backticks, heredoc, {block} import), but it misses the quoted-address HasSuffix check, leaves the quoted "{}" branch unfixed, and keeps a now-redundant wasQuoted check in directive().

Essentially equivalent to the reference, with Token predicates and all brace checks updated, including the address suffix and quoted `{}`; tests are reasonable table entries with nesting and heredoc cases but are less in-depth than some others.

Nearly identical to the reference: unquoted-brace helpers on Token are used at every structural check, including the quoted-address suffix check and the quoted "{}" branch, and table tests cover nested blocks and heredocs.
